pages.text: [#](53341a)They exist because we exist. Witch Hunters are organised, motivated, and unpleasant — they track vampires and werewolves as a profession.[#]() [#](53341a)They attack at range with crossbows of silver bolts and close to melee when needed.[#]()
pages.title: Witch Hunters

pages.text: [#](53341a)Silver does extra damage to the transformed; silvered armor reduces but does not erase it.[#]()

pages.name: Witch Hunter
pages.text: [#](53341a)Known by the hat, the coat, and the look of someone certain of their cause. They drop silver bolts and the occasional armour piece.[#]()
